summary: @servicetitan/anvil-icons ships preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executing obfuscated bundle
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime for the current platform from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it, chmods it executable, and then invokes the just-downloaded Bun binary to execute a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line Bun-CJS bundle with string-array rotation, hex-numbered identifiers (`MmgoCP`, `WV8StW`, `n7gIxM`), and a large mixed numeric/string constant table — heavily obfuscated and unrelated to any icon-library functionality. The bundle executes automatically on `npm install` under a runtime that was fetched at install time, so the code running on the installer's host is opaque and outside the Node-based auditing surface. The package presents vendor-aligned metadata (name `@servicetitan/anvil-icons`, homepage `https://v1.anvil.servicetitan.com`, repo `github:servicetitan/anvil`) while its actual install-time behavior is an obfuscated dropper with no relationship to icons, consistent with a scoped-name impersonation of ServiceTitan's Anvil design system rather than a legitimate first-party release.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
